Quest.Name: Keep the World
Quest.Accomplishment: You sealed the Root with the three name-holding stones. The world is kept.

Objectives.Text: Carry tepuibone, memory-marble and mute-stone to the Root -- the stump's crown, two chunks north of the Felling-Site -- go down, and seal the taproot's face. Kept: the Thinning halts; nothing heals; the Six survive as themselves. Tepuibone lies loose at the Root's cleft; the Recension Searcher at Quillhold has memory-marble; the Curation Indexer at the Salt-Vault has mute-stone. Either giver will release you from this if you say so.

Quest.Name: Gather the World
Quest.Accomplishment: You let the Choir into the Root. The world is gathered.

Objectives.Text: Carry the Choir's cutting to the Root -- the stump's crown, two chunks north of the Felling-Site -- go down, and set it against the taproot's face. Gathered: nothing is ever lost, and no one remains. Any choir tendril will release you from this if you say so.
